summary: Implementation meets all 6 acceptance criteria. The deviation from self._scoped_val_df to self._cached_slim_val is correct and necessary (scoped_val_df is freed to None at line 2365 during __init__). slim_backtest_df preserves META_COLUMNS (datetime, symbol) and LABEL_COLUMNS, so build_monthly_windows and _evaluate_rule_on_window have all needed columns. Both call sites updated, defensive None guard present at both sites, audit-finding #4 linkage in comments, 3 new tests cover val-source assertion, None-skip guard, and non-trivial filtering. All 211 tests pass across 4 suites. Diff is minimal and surgical — no out-of-scope changes.

acceptance_criteria.1_call_sites_use_val_df: PASS — Both call sites (lines 2841, 3328) use self._cached_slim_val. Deviation from self._scoped_val_df is justified: scoped_val_df is None at call time (freed at line 2365). PLAN.md explicitly recommended _cached_slim_val.
acceptance_criteria.2_test_confirms_val_df: PASS — test_gate_uses_cached_slim_val monkeypatches build_monthly_windows, records the DataFrame, asserts it is NOT gen._train_df and has datetime >= 2022-01-01 (val range).
acceptance_criteria.3_non_trivial_filtering: PASS — test_non_trivial_filtering_on_val confirms 50% rejection (2/4 rules kept) with mixed-profitability rules across 6 months.
acceptance_criteria.4_none_guard: PASS — Both call sites guard on self._cached_slim_val is None with logger.warning. test_gate_skipped_when_cached_slim_val_none verifies warning logged and build_monthly_windows NOT called.
acceptance_criteria.5_comment_accuracy: PASS — Comments updated from 'train split' to 'val split (OOS stability check)' with '→ fixes audit finding #4' linkage at both sites.
acceptance_criteria.6_all_existing_tests_pass: PASS — 10/10 in test_phase2_monthly_admission.py, 211/211 across 4 suites (rule_pool, window_rotation, island_scheduler, monthly_admission).

deviation_assessment.scoped_val_df_vs_cached_slim_val: JUSTIFIED — self._scoped_val_df is set to None at line 2365 during __init__ (before the gate call sites at 2841/3328). Using it would make the gate always skip. self._cached_slim_val is the slim_backtest_df output which preserves META_COLUMNS (datetime, symbol) and LABEL_COLUMNS — all columns needed by build_monthly_windows and _evaluate_rule_on_window. PLAN.md explicitly recommended this attribute.
deviation_assessment.column_availability: VERIFIED — slim_backtest_df (backtest/df_slim.py) retains META_COLUMNS=['datetime','symbol'] + LABEL_COLUMNS + _symbol_bar_index + feature columns. build_monthly_windows requires 'datetime' (present). _evaluate_rule_on_window requires label/meta columns (present).

out_of_scope_check.task_5_or_later_preview: NONE — no dead f3 branch deletion or overfit ratio gate pre-implementation
out_of_scope_check.context_and_task_md_changes: ORCHESTRATOR WORKFLOW UPDATES — CONTEXT.md advances state from task-3 to task-4; task-4.md was rewritten by orchestrator to match PLAN.md task-4 spec (replaced placeholder from prior plan iteration). Not production code.

notes_for_code_reviewer: The defensive guard structure (if None → warn/skip, elif enabled → run) is duplicated at both call sites. Code reviewer may want to note this for potential extraction into a helper, but it's acceptable for a surgical 2-site fix.

test_gate_skipped_when_cached_slim_val_none uses object.__new__ + manual attribute setup to avoid __init__ side effects. This is fragile but functional — code reviewer should assess if a simpler construction path exists.
The test_gate_uses_cached_slim_val test asserts gen._scoped_val_df is None as a sanity check, which independently validates the deviation justification.
